\section*{Question 1}
\begin{itemize}
\item[] In the figure above, \(R\) is the shaded region in the first quadrant bounded by the graph of \(y=4 \ln (3-x)\), the horizontal line \(y=6\), and the vertical line \(x=2\).
\item[(a)] Find the area of \(R\).
\item[(b)] Find the volume of the solid generated when \(R\) is revolved about the horizontal line \(y=8\).
(c) The region \(R\) is the base of a solid. For this solid, each cross section perpendicular to the \(x\)-axis is a square. Find the volume of the solid.
